summary: Comcast Corporation and its subsidiary commenced cash tender offers for eight series of outstanding senior notes maturing 2027–2029. The offers are for any and all of each series, with pricing based on a fixed spread over the applicable benchmark Treasury yield. No premium percentage or aggregate consideration was disclosed in this initial announcement. The board has not issued a recommendation, and no advisors were named. The offers are funded with cash on hand, reducing future interest expense and outstanding debt. The tender is open until a specified expiration date; what to watch is the acceptance priority and whether all tendered notes are purchased.
